Please review and accept the following before applying.

Seller Terms. You're entering a marketplace agreement with Marcato as an independent seller; you're responsible for the products you list, their accuracy, and fulfilling orders on time.

Marketplace Rules. You'll deal with customers professionally, keep stock levels accurate, and won't manipulate reviews, pricing, or search ranking.

Product/Listing Policies. Listings must be accurate, use images you have rights to, and correctly categorised.

Prohibited-Products Policy. No counterfeit, stolen, hazardous, weapons, or items illegal to sell in Nigeria.

Returns/Refund Requirements. You'll honour Marcato's baseline returns window and process refunds promptly for valid claims.

Payout/Commission Terms. Marcato deducts an agreed commission per sale before payout to your verified bank account.

Privacy/Verification Consent. You consent to Marcato verifying your identity and bank details as part of onboarding, and processing your data to run your seller account.
